authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong photorealism with detailed feather textures and natural lighting. However, structural integrity issues exist: feet of penguins #2 and #4 show fusion/melting into the snow surface with indistinct toe boundaries. The central penguin's flipper lacks crisp separation from body plumage. Animal pose auditor flagged MEDIUM artifact risk (29% low-confidence keypoints) concentrated in front limbs and face regions, corroborating visual observations of anatomical imprecision at contact points and facial features.
key_defects: Count mismatch: 5 penguins generated instead of requested 6.
Species mismatch: Generated Gentoo-like penguins (white head band, orange bill) instead of requested King Penguins (orange neck patches, yellow breast transition).
Foot-ground fusion artifacts on multiple penguins where toes lack definition against snow.
Flipper-body boundary softness on central penguin indicating structural collapse.
